verdict.rationale: Canny offers a JavaScript SDK for identifying users and an official MCP server for LLM-based workflows, giving AI-native users some official building blocks, but there's no evidence of broader multi-language SDKs, an OpenAPI spec, or an official API client library for programmatic agentic use. missing for 10: OpenAPI/API client SDKs (openapi probes all 404), multi-language SDK coverage, independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK robustness.
